exposure: booked antenatal care at <13 weeks of gestation
booked antenatal care at 13-26 weeks of gestation
cohort: A total of 77,026 babies born at or admitted to 54 referral-level facilities in Nigeria between September 1, 2019, and August 31, 2020.
finding: The incidence of neonatal jaundice was 41.92 per 1000 live births among all babies, with risk factors including certain educational levels, previous caesarean section, early or mid-gestation antenatal care booking, preterm birth, and prolonged labour.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for neonatal jaundice.
cross-section timing: Data collected between 1 September 2019 and 31 August 2020
